title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openssh security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A security advisory from Red Hat addresses multiple vulnerabilities in OpenSSH, including information disclosure via shared compression side-channel, arbitrary file write through directory traversal during SFTP recursive copy, credential disclosure via failed GSSAPI authentication, denial of service via oversized decompressed packets, and command injection via unvalidated command-line username. These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 across various architectures. The advisory rates the overall security impact as Moderate and provides updated packages to fix these vulnerabilities.
